Our logistics driver will deliver the raw materials directly to your home address on Monday. You can register your address via https://craftlogix-careers.example/dispatch.

Before we dispatch the consignment, all home workers must purchase the Starter Safety & Tool Kit for 4,200 LKR. This includes branded sealers, cutters, and training guidebooks.
Is this kit fee compulsory? Can't you deduct it from my first salary payout?
Company policy strictly requires advance payment for the starter kit to confirm courier insurance. The 4,200 LKR is 100% refundable with your first weekly stipend.

messages.text: Good day! I am Shalini from TranscribeCloud Lanka. We are recruiting remote audio transcribers for general Sinhala and English audio files.

You can choose your own hours. We pay 1,200 LKR per audio hour submitted. On average, our typists make around 55,000 LKR each month.
That fits my criteria very well. How can I start receiving audio projects?

This is not an interview fee; it covers your secure audio server account creation and software license. Once you pay 1,950 LKR, your username and password will be sent instantly.

Unfortunately, server setup is fully automated and will not generate your login without payment confirmation. Contact our accounts desk at 07X-XXX-XXXX for direct slip submission.

Okay, done. Attached is the proof capture.
Super! We have credited 400 LKR to your temporary ledger. Now, complete task #2 on https://trendwave-portal.example/link-task-2 for another 400 LKR.
Completed that as well! Here is the screenshot. Total is 800 LKR now, right?
Accurate! Your current balance is 800 LKR. To unlock cash withdrawal to your local bank account, you must complete the special VIP Merchant Optimization Task.
How does this VIP merchant optimization work?
You select an investment bracket: minimum is 10,000 LKR. You transfer 10,000 LKR to our corporate merchant account, boost a merchant shop rating, and within 15 minutes withdraw 13,500 LKR.
Wait, I came here to earn money, not to invest 10,000 LKR of my own money.
It is not an expense, friend. It is a merchant escrow task. The funds return to you immediately with a 35% commission. Without it, the 800 LKR trial credit cannot be disbursed.
